Defence Minister Rajnath Singh highlighted the contributions of ITBP towards internal security and border safeguarding. Meanwhile, the Indian Army and Home Minister Amit Shah also conveyed their regards.

candidates.title: Who is Himanshu Bhau? One of India's most wanted gangsters; Lawrence Bishnoi rival - Why he was arrested? Latest update
candidates.excerpt: The FBI has arrested Himanshu Bhau, a 24-year-old Indian gangster wanted in Delhi, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh for crimes including murder, extortion and kidnapping. Accused of leading a major gang and operating from abroad, Bhau is a rival of jailed gangster Lawrence Bishnoi.
